name: @wirebabel/pi-web-access
description: Pi web-access extension and transitional host for pre-split browser automation tools
author: wirebabel

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test

piManifestNote: The repo root Pi manifest loads this extension entrypoint directly; repo-level skills are declared from root ./skills/* and vendor paths, not from this package.

packageBoundary.current: Transitional extension host: web search, fetch, cookies, YouTube transcripts, frontend LLM browser automation, native computer-use tools, editor helpers, cockpit, and agent-server registrations.
packageBoundary.target: Keep @wirebabel/pi-web-access focused on search/fetch/cookies/YouTube after T-2026-06-09-005 package-split moves land.
packageBoundary.splitPolicy: No-move cleanup slices may update manifests, scripts, and docs only; file moves require a dedicated package migration.
